title: Trackpad
drDigitalIntro:
The trackpad is the flat rectangle below your keyboard — it is your laptop's built-in pointing tool.
• Moving your fingertip across it moves the arrow on screen, called the cursor.
• Tapping it (or pressing it down) is a left click — use it to select things.
• If you are using an external mouse instead, that is perfectly fine. A mouse does the same job.
• On a mouse: the left button is the main click; the scroll wheel scrolls pages up and down; the right button opens an extra menu.
• On a trackpad: one finger tap = left click; two-finger tap = right click; two-finger drag = scroll; pinch = zoom.
drDigitalSuccess: That is the trackpad. You will use it constantly, so there is a whole lesson on it coming up.
drDigitalHint: Take a moment to find your own trackpad, then click Continue when you're ready.
